before: Finding the laid-out fragment of a paragraph scanned the pages from the start on every read, so the Decrease Indent state over a long selection read the pages once per paragraph.
after: Each layout keeps the first fragment of each paragraph, loaded page by page as reads need it, and answers the same fragment as before.
reason: Only a read-side cache over an immutable layout changes. No shared field, operation, node identity, snapshot, or awareness payload changes, and each peer builds its own cache from its own layout.
